sloka: रक्षसां भूषणस्थाभिर्भाभिः स्वाभिश्च सर्वशः।चक्रुस्ते सप्रभं व्योम हरयश्चाग्निभिः सह ।। ६.७५.४९ ।।
transliteration: rakṣasāṁ bhūṣaṇasthābhirbhābhiḥ svābhiśca sarvaśaḥ।cakruste saprabhaṁ vyoma harayaścāgnibhiḥ saha ।। 6.75.49 ।।

translations.english: Roaring like a lion, he ordered all the Rakshasas of extraordinary strength to proceed instantly.
